email_domains.only_ours_unproved: Only our organisation needs a domain this organisation has proved.
validation.payment_reminder_days: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 30.
staff.link_needs_mobile: Add a mobile number to send a link.
door_codes.role: A code cannot give edit access, or let anyone run the floor. Give those to a named person instead.
door_codes.use_cap_required: Enter how many people can use this code.
door_codes.use_cap_range: Use a whole number from 1 to 500.
door_codes.expiry_past: Choose a time that has not passed yet.
door_codes.not_made: The door code was not made. Check your connection and try again.
door_codes.invalid: That code does not work. Check it with whoever gave it to you.
door_codes.member: You are already a member of {organisation}. Members open an event from its People page. Ask its lead or an admin to add you.
validation.course_default_not_asked: Only a course that asks guests something can have a default.
validation.course_default_dish_needed: Choose a default dish, or clear the choose-by date.
validation.course_choose_by_needed: Enter a choose-by date, or set the default to No default.
validation.course_choose_by_after_event: Choose a date before the event.
validation.course_choose_by_past: That date has passed. Choose today or later.
validation.course_choose_by_locked: The choose-by date has passed, so the date is locked.
menu.default_dish: {dish} is {course}’s default. Choose another default first, in Edit course.
menu.default_variant: {variant} is {course}’s default variant. Choose another default first, in Edit course.
menu.default_option: {option} is part of {course}’s default. Choose another default first, in Edit course.
menu.default_move: Changing the default moves the guests given it. Confirm to change it.
menu.change_asks: This change asks guests to pick again. Confirm to change it.
menu.event_over: This event’s date has passed, so its menu can’t change. Nothing was changed.
phone_sign_in.alternative: This is an alternative number on a Soirely account, so it cannot sign you in.
invitations.needs_email: Add that address to your account and verify it, then accept the invitation.
billing.plan_sold_by_contract: This plan is sold by contract, not through checkout. Contact Soirely to arrange it.
billing.plan_not_priced: This plan has no price in your billing currency.
billing.nothing_paid_through_provider: There is no payment method to update until a plan is paid for.
validation.audience_group_unknown: That group is not one of this event’s groups.
validation.audience_conditions_list: Send the conditions as a list.
validation.saved_audience_name_required: Enter a name for this audience.
validation.saved_audience_name_too_long: A saved audience’s name can be up to {max} characters.
validation.guest_message_conditions_requ: Add a condition first. With none, Guests who… matches nobody, so there is nothing to send or save.
validation.guest_message_nobody_matches: Nobody matches these conditions, so there is no one to send it to.
saved_audience.name_taken: There is already a saved audience called {name}.
service.table_not_yours: This table is in somebody else’s section. Ask them or the floor lead.
door_codes.run_floor: A join code cannot let people run the floor. Give Can run the floor to one person, with their own link from the roster.
people.service_level_outside_only: The service levels are for people working a shift. Give a member one of the event roles.
service.tray_not_yours: This tray is {name}’s. Ask them or the floor lead.
service.plate_stage_invalid: This plate cannot take that step from where it is now.
service.plate_empty: A plate with nothing on it is not taken to a guest. Take it off the tray instead.
service.table_nothing_to_serve: There is nothing to put on a tray for this table yet.
service.tray_check_incomplete: Mark every item On, or Not on and Bring after, before checking the tray.
service.undo_expired: It is more than 2 minutes since that step, so it cannot be undone.
service.undo_not_last: Something else has changed since that step. Undo the later change first.
service.ready_in_invalid: Ready in about can be 5, 10 or 15 minutes, and is set only while the item is Preparing.
service.item_not_on_course: That item is not on this course.
service.item_not_on_plate: That item is not on this plate.
service.changed: This changed while you were offline. Nothing was changed.
service.expected_required: Send what the tap saw with each service step.
service.idempotency_key_required: Send an Idempotency-Key with each service step.
service.idempotency_key_reused: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different step. Nothing was changed.
